svg.title: Friday — System Architecture (develop)
svg.text: A personal agent for one user (Zeep) · version 0.9.0 (develop, 31 Oct 2026) · Manchester CS Final Year Project
one web page, three ways in
Ctrl+Alt+F shows / hides it · hold Right Ctrl to talk
Resident launcher; opens the cloud Friday in an app window
Safari → Add to Home Screen (no App Store build)
Service worker shows her Web Push notifications
Run the evaluation task set on the same agent
Chat bubbles · emoji reactions · photos & screenshots · confirm cards he can edit · Undo · tap to dictate / hold to talk · read aloud · profile page (cost, memory, push settings)
FastAPI · src/main.py · Docker on Fly.io (app friday-jimmy, London, always on) · or locally on 127.0.0.1:8765
the opener: timeline card + one sentence
profile page: cost, what she remembers
version · model in use · live git_sha
speech → text → a turn · text → speech
HTTPS · JSON, her reply streams back as Server-Sent Events
reactive path: he says something, the model decides
Fresh instructions every turn: persona, the time now, calendar (today → next
Sunday), to-dos, reminders, profile, memory, open frictions
Runner.run_streamed(): model ↔ tool loop, up to 12 model calls; the session is
the SQLite history, tool results included
Outward or destructive tools stop the run (needs_approval). The paused run is
saved and resumes only on a plain yes
His own to-dos, events and reminders run straight away; Undo reverts them
A thread that grows too long rolls over, carrying its last lines
Claude through the Anthropic Messages API, persona prompt-cached. If Claude cannot
answer (credit, limit, outage), GPT-5 takes that call and the next 5 minutes.
only if a list is connected
Dates, counts, priorities and when to interrupt him are
computed here, so they are fast, free and never made up. The
Opener 「现在」: one sentence and one action, then a
timeline. Focus: important meeting within 3 h → overdue →
Calendar today → next Sunday in local time; 「周四」 → a
「三点提醒我…」 → an exact time; fires on the minute
Scheduler every 60 s (cloud): morning brief, meeting in 20
min–2 h, due today after 17:00, 21:00 wrap-up. At most 3 a
Cursor finished, change live, develop CI red → a push,
VAPID-signed Web Push to the iPhone app and the desktop
Tap Done / Tomorrow without the model; every closed loop
Exact token cost per call; usage metadata only, never
The opener and every push are also written into the
conversation, so on his next message the model knows
what she has already told him.
Web Push: she comes to find him
chosen in .env; the tools and the server-computed side share them
google — every selected calendar, incl. the
imported university timetable; creates events in
gmail · imap (163, QQ: IMAP + SMTP) · outlook
several.py reads every mailbox together; a reply
leaves from the mailbox the mail came to
google — the Google Tasks default list
mock · none (then to-dos are never mentioned)
GPT-5: the brain without it, and Claude's
whisper-1) for speech; gpt-4o-mini-tts to read
her voice when a key is set
edits Friday's own repo on a branch, after he
pull request, CI status, merge into develop only
one OAuth sign-in for all three
FRIDAY_STATE_DIR · both paths read and write it · on Fly a mounted volume, /state
SQLite: the model's session and the thread the page shows
paused runs waiting for his yes
his devices, VAPID key, push limits
frictions, mistakes · cost and usage · photos
Survives deploys and restarts. In the repo: data/personal/profile.md (who he is), data/*.json mock data; OAuth
tokens in secrets/ (on Fly, from secrets).
GitHub Actions run Tests on every push, and Deploy Friday (tests first) on every push to develop. main holds
milestones only (tag baseline-v1). Cursor's branches reach develop only through ship_pending_fix: he says yes,
Generated from the code on develop; update with the code.
